blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Some 204 of 213 foreigners rounded up in the towns of Alicia and Siay in Zamboanga del Sur province on Friday are Chinese nationals. According to Brig. Gen. Samuel Yunque, commander of the Army’s 102nd Infantry Brigade, the total number of persons rounded up was 222, nine of whom are Filipinos and 213 foreigners. Some 84 of them were located in Siay town and the rest in Alicia town.
